facebook.content:
**Prayer Focus – Family**  
Our homes are under attack; the enemy seeks to sow division and doubt.  

Lord, we declare Your peace reigning in every household. We break every scheme of discord and raise a generation rooted in love, truth, and obedience to Your Word. Let Your presence be the foundation that no storm can move.  

If you stand in agreement, drop a 🙏. Have a specific need? Share it below.

instagram.content:
Family – a home where the Spirit reigns.  
We see tension, fear, and unanswered needs, yet the Kingdom calls us to walk in divine unity.  

Lord, we declare Your peace covering every heart, Your truth binding every word, and Your power restoring every broken relationship. Let Your love be the foundation that no storm can shake.  

Drop 🙏 if you stand with us, or share your prayer need below.
